# hpe_morpheus_cluster_namespace (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Cluster Namespace resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_cluster_namespace" "example" {
  cluster_id = 1
  name       = "example-namespace"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) The ID of the cluster.
- `name` (String) The name of the namespace.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the namespace is active.
- `description` (String) The description of the namespace.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the cluster namespace.

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_cluster_namespace.example 123
```
